title: Operations
description: What runs in the background, for every tenant together: the job queues, the outbox and its dead letters, and a live log of the engines.

queues.name: Queue
queues.retryDescription: {{count}} failed jobs go back to the queue and run again.
queues.retried_one: {{count}} job put back in the queue.
queues.retried_other: {{count}} jobs put back in the queue.
queues.pauseDescription: No worker takes its jobs until it is resumed. Nothing is lost; running jobs finish. The outbox keeps adding jobs: see Backlog.
queues.resumeDescription: The workers take its jobs again.

outbox.latest: The latest {{shown}} are listed; the actions for all reach every dead letter.
outbox.requeueOneDescription: The message for {{topic}} goes back to the outbox and is tried again.
outbox.requeueAllDescription: All dead letters (currently {{count}}) go back to the outbox and are tried again.
outbox.purgeOneDescription: The message for {{topic}} is deleted for good. It can't be requeued afterwards.
outbox.purgeAllDescription: All dead letters (currently {{count}}) are deleted for good. They can't be requeued afterwards.

events.description: {{count}} events in the log, newest first. The log keeps the latest 200.
events.empty: Nothing yet. Events appear here as the engines work.

backlog.intro: Count and recover the outbox and mail backlog of one tenant, or of every tenant when you say so. A mandatory notification, essential mail and running work are never discarded. Every change is audited.
backlog.scopeHint: Count first: the actions apply to the scope counted. Leave a filter empty to include everything.
backlog.outbox: Outbox: {{pending}} pending, {{dead}} dead letters, {{leased}} being delivered
backlog.capped: More jobs than counted: the numbers are a floor.
backlog.discardDescription: Deleted for good. Discarded notifications stay in each person's list, marked delivered, with no push, mail or webhook.
backlog.retryDescription: They run again. The mail mode and the daily budgets still apply.
